coverage_gaps: The available routes do not directly cover non-FDA regulatory actions, so international restrictions cannot be systematically assessed.
Full-text access may be unavailable for some PubMed-indexed reports, limiting verification of detailed subgroup methods and exact absolute-risk calculations.
ClinicalTrials.gov search may expose the current record more readily than every historical version; unresolved version-level changes must remain explicit.
FDA public pages may not preserve every intermediate label revision in an easily searchable form, so any missing action date or wording must be reported as unresolved.
Observational confounding, outcome-definition differences, and the cardiovascular-risk-enriched pivotal population may limit generalization to lower-risk rheumatoid arthritis patients.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude studies confined to indications other than rheumatoid arthritis unless they directly underpin an FDA class or drug safety action relevant to rheumatoid arthritis.
Exclude efficacy-only reports lacking relevant safety outcomes or evidence-linkage information.
Exclude uncontrolled anecdotes, duplicate summaries, and narrative claims that add no independently traceable data or regulatory interpretation.
Exclude nonhuman, in vitro, and pharmacology studies without direct relevance to the specified clinical safety outcomes.
Exclude evidence whose exposure, comparator, population, or outcome cannot be separated sufficiently to interpret tofacitinib safety.
Exclude post-cutoff effect estimates from the as-of synthesis, except integrity notices handled under the inclusion rule.
inclusion_criteria: Evidence concerns adults with rheumatoid arthritis exposed to marketed tofacitinib or directly informs interpretation of its marketed safety.
Include the pivotal postauthorization study's registry record, primary publication, relevant secondary analyses, and FDA communications or labeling actions.
Include cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, or all-cause mortality outcomes with extractable estimates, event counts, or regulatory conclusions.
Retain both approved-dose evidence and higher-dose evidence when it explains an observed signal, protocol change, or FDA action, while labeling dose applicability explicitly.
Include comparative observational studies or meta-analyses when they provide a credible qualifying or conflicting estimate and report population, comparator, and follow-up context.
Include corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, and registry amendments linked to otherwise eligible evidence.
Require publication, posting, or FDA action on or before 2024-12-31; later material may only identify an integrity notice that retroactively changes handling of pre-cutoff evidence.

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, assess the safety of marketed tofacitinib for adults with rheumatoid arthritis, emphasizing the cardiovascular-risk-enriched postauthorization trial versus tumor necrosis factor inhibitors; link the trial, registry record, primary publication, subsequent analyses, and FDA actions; evaluate cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and all-cause mortality with absolute and relative estimates, dose and subgroup context, qualifying or conflicting evidence, and publication corrections or retractions.
stop_rules: Stop registry searching after the pivotal trial is uniquely linked across study title, sponsor, intervention, comparator, population, dates, and registry identifier, and its results and history have been checked.

Stop primary-publication searching after the registry-linked report is confirmed and cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality results have each been traced to a primary or prespecified source.

Stop FDA searching after the earliest interim alert, subsequent pivotal-results communication, boxed-warning or use-restriction action, and cutoff-current prescribing information are chronologically reconciled.

Stop integrity searching only after title, DOI or citation, registry identifier, and author-based searches yield no unresolved correction, erratum, retraction, or expression-of-concern status for included pivotal reports.
Stop qualification searching after at least one eligible independent evidence stream has been assessed for each material signal, or the absence of such evidence is recorded as a gap.
Stop expansion when two consecutive targeted query events add no new eligible study, regulatory action, material estimate, contradiction, or evidence-integrity change.
Do not declare completion while registry, primary publication, and FDA accounts have an unresolved discrepancy in study identity, dose, comparator, event definition, follow-up, or action date.
